Resolving Changes Calling DataAdapter.Update() inspects the RowState of every DataRow in memory and executes the required command back to the database: • Added = InsertCommand • Modified = UpdateCommand • Deleted = DeleteCommand Rule: Process Deletes first, Updates second, and Inserts last. 2. Return Value Mapping Use UpdateRowSource to map returned database values back to memory. FirstReturnedRecord is useful for retrieving auto-generated keys. 3. Identity Columns vs. GUIDs • Identity: Generates sequential integers unique only to that specific server. Unsafe for distributed systems.
